name: audit-dataclass-patterns
description: Audit frozen dataclasses using object.__setattr__ across the codebase. Cross-file analysis task.
task: We had a bug where a frozen dataclass was mutated via object.__setattr__. Audit all frozen dataclasses in src/justhtml/ — find which files use @dataclass(frozen=True) and which of those also use object.__setattr__ to bypass immutability. Write the full audit to docs/dataclass-audit.md listing each class name, which file it's in, and whether it uses object.__setattr__.
